correctness.rationale: Solving two first-order backward boundary systems yields p=(1+K)^(-1) and τ=p(L+2B)/v with correct outgoing-state boundary data. A uniform bound e^(-K)>0 on direct uninterrupted escape yields finite expectation. Positivity gives 0<centroid<L. Strictly positive exponential tilts span every centroid, and cosine perturbations preserve both measured moments. Exact formulas were independently crosschecked by event-driven stochastic simulation.

value.rationale: This determines a complete experimentally meaningful two-observable feasible region for an arbitrarily structured active medium, not a fixed-rate evaluation. It identifies which two integrated rate moments a side-resolved exit experiment plus an unconditioned mean residence measurement recovers and gives constructive smooth profiles achieving every compatible pair, with rigorously sharp unattained limits and infinite nonidentifiability. The conclusion contrasts boundary injection with interior-start response and provides useful inverse-design limits.
